title.narrative: Integrated Health Program (IHP) Task Order Four (TO4)

description.narrative: (Nigeria): With FY 2022 funds this activity will:.Provide health system support to the Kebbi State Government to plan, budget and coordinate the implementation of primary health care services in the state and advocate for improved health system governance;.Build the capacity of healthcare workers to provide quality, equitable primary health services and to reach underserved populations; .Issue small grants to local organizations to provide technical assistance and capacity building support to health facilities in provision of nutrition services, gender based violence and informal sector enrollment in financial risk protection schemes; .Promote the adoption of essential WASH actions such as environmental hygiene handwashing and safe disposal of waste at the facility levels in Kebbi State; and.Work with government stakeholders to strengthen facility-level results reporting, develop an annual operational plan, implement the plan and develop data use for decision making and service quality improvement. .This activity will strengthen health systems and increase access to and improve the quality of primary health care services in supported states in Nigeria. It will work in Kebbi State to support the bilateral MOU with Kebbi State Government to reduce maternal and child mortality in the state, and to increase public and private health systems' skills to sustainably supervise and manage quality primary health care services. This activity contributes to USAID priorities by focusing on evidence-based interventions, sustainability, localization and capacity building. It also contributes directly to USAID Nigeria CDCS Development Objective 2, the Embassy's ICS, and is closely aligned with Goal 3 of the 2022-2026 Joint Strategic Plan..
